Definition: a caller, i.e. partridge (from its cry)
BiblicalUsage: David tells Saul the king has come out to seek a flea, as when one hunts a partridge in the mountains, and Jeremiah says the partridge that sits on eggs she did not lay is like the man who gets riches and not by right. The word is the caller, the partridge named for its cry.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the partridge that hatches eggs not her own is the picture of riches got by wrong, and Jeremiah says they will leave him.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
